newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates steady on spinners' demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates steady on spinners' demand.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates were steady on Monday amid selective buying by spinners but were likely to fall amid rising supply of fresh arrivals from the new crop, dealers said.
"Selective buying by spinners helped prices remain stable," dealer Naseem Usman said.
He said the prices would fall in the next few sessions as supply of fresh arrivals from the 1997/98 crop was rising.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,250 rupees ($55.39) per maund (37.32 k.g) and the MNH-93 at 2,260 rupees, dealers said.
